exposure: Other second-generation antipsychotic use during pregnancy
High-risk metabolic second-generation antipsychotic use during pregnancy (olanzapine, clozapine, quetiapine)
cohort: 1,307,487 singleton births in Sweden between July 2006 and December 2017
finding: Use of olanzapine, clozapine, and quetiapine during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes and infants being large for gestational age.
